Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>hi has anyone the spoiler for this card (gregory winter Rare)
>can find it in the archive

Have you tried checking the White Wolf forums?

Short answer:

He's a Unique Ghoul ally who costs 2 pool has 4 life, 1 strength, 1 bleed.
During your untap, he burns/loses a life. As a +1 stealth (D) action, he can
steal a blood from a vampire controlled by another Methusaleh. He can also burn
a vampire in torpor as a (D) action to gain 2 life.

Halcyan 2

No, any action that has a cost, you don't pay if you're blocked.
Goes for Kalinda, Tereza Rostas, any action with a cost, whether
or not it has a library card associated with it. And it would for
Gregory Winter except that his action doesn't cost anything, he
just burns a life during your untap. :-)
